plan.rationale: For this summer jazz festival poster, the canvas will be filled with a vibrant yet not overwhelming design that captures the essence of a Friday night in the park. The title will be bold and attention-grabbing, with a clean, modern typeface. The image will feature a silhouette of a saxophonist playing under the stars, evoking the joy and energy of a live performance. The background will be a gradient of blues and purples, fading into a warm, golden hue to represent the summer evening transitioning into night. The text will be concise, focusing on key information and using a legible sans-serif font for readability.
palette_intent: A gradient of blues and purples fading into a warm, golden hue
Bright, clean white text for contrast
